def test_package_carries_research_questions_from_k07(world) -> None:
    led, model = world
    plan = P.plan_next(led, model, "b", SPECS, steps=("exists",))
    wp = led.get(plan.work_package_id)
    asked = [s for s in wp.implementation_requirements if s.startswith("research first: How should we close:")]
    assert asked and len(asked) <= 3


def test_retry_package_prioritises_the_earlier_failure_question(world) -> None:
    led, model = world
    first = P.plan_next(led, model, "b", SPECS, steps=("exists",))
    led.transition(first.work_package_id, M.Status.IN_PROGRESS, "start", M.Role.KERNEL)
    P.record_outcome(led, first, False, "tests assert nothing")
    second = P.plan_next(led, model, "b", SPECS, steps=("exists",))
    reqs = led.get(second.work_package_id).implementation_requirements
    assert any("earlier attempt failed" in s and "tests assert nothing" in s for s in reqs)
EOF
